title: terrarium
subtitle: generative music in a jar, for monome norns
about: The real terrarium script, running in your browser. Weather falls on a landscape and plays where it lands; you choose what lives in each part of the jar and shape it with two knobs. Press Start sound, then turn E1 to pick a part and E2/E3 to shape it. The sound is Mutable Instruments' code, the same a norns plays, compiled for the browser.
